name: Shinrigaku Kara Hajimaru Ren'ai Jijou
original_name: 心理学から始まる恋愛事情
source:
The protagonist Kazuki has never had a girlfriend, nor the courage to even talk to girls.
Finding himself in university now, he decides now is his chance to get a girlfriend!
However, despite his motivation, he makes no progress at all.

Feeling down, he spends his days off watching videos online, until one day,
he finds "Saku Channel", a channel that uploads videos about Psychology.

This "Saku" studies psychology and romance.
Kazuki can't get enough of it.
He decides to use the knowledge from the channel on the heroines he desires...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ293051.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主角一树从来没有过女朋友，甚至连和女孩子说话的勇气都没有。
现在他已经上了大学，他决定现在是他交女朋友的机会了！
然而，尽管他有动力，但他却毫无进展。

心情低落的他，休息日就上网看视频，直到有一天，
他找到了“Saku Channel”，一个上传心理学视频的频道。

这位“佐久”研究心理学和浪漫主义。
一树还不够。
他决定将频道中的知识用于他想要的女主角……
